task: Close the trusted Release Unit Execution Atlas evidence gap so canonical Release Risk can be recomputed against exact source HEAD without trusting source-controlled proof artifacts or weakening Atlas/Release Risk authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal executor run 37534207237 consumed exact source HEAD 1a3cdb897fc1ed2dab7b04e270a7762cbb23b579 with trusted main code and recomputed Plan Before Code PASS, but canonical Release Risk blocked because artifacts/shoperation-quality/change-impact.json was absent. release-risk-budget.mjs requires Atlas change-impact evidence; the executor currently invokes Plan and Release Risk but omits the existing trusted Knowledge/Atlas producer.
observableOutcomes: Trusted Release Unit Execution recomputes existing Knowledge/Atlas evidence with default-branch code against the exact admitted source SHA before canonical Release Risk recomputation.
The produced change-impact evidence is exact-head and matches the source diff; Release Risk remains unchanged and consumes the existing canonical artifact.
The executor does not trust or download source-controlled Knowledge/Atlas proof artifacts as authoritative evidence.
Proof subprocesses used only to recompute evidence do not gain an independent write authority and repository write tokens are not required for the Knowledge/Atlas producer.
Regression proof locks the ordering: fetch source → trusted Knowledge/Atlas evidence → trusted Plan → trusted Release Risk → driver.
unresolvedRisks: Running Knowledge preflight against trusted main checkout must still evaluate the exact source diff rather than main.
A write-capable job must not accidentally expose its repository token to proof logic that does not need writes.
The fix must not create a second Atlas or Release Risk authority or consume untrusted source artifacts.
The executor must remain blocked if trusted Knowledge/Atlas or Release Risk recomputation fails.

in: Wire the existing shoperation-knowledge-preflight.mjs into the trusted default-branch Release Unit Execution workflow before Release Risk recomputation, bound to exact source HEAD and source plan.
Ensure the existing change-impact artifact is produced in the trusted workspace for release-risk-budget.mjs.
Add regression assertions in the existing production release surface test.
out: No change to release-risk-budget.mjs policy or scoring.
No change to Atlas authority/graph semantics, decomposition, CAS state, child PR execution, Completion Truth or Lifecycle authority.
No source-CI proof artifact promotion into trusted executor evidence.
No storefront, admin, database, auth, payment, inventory, Builder or template behavior change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The change sits inside a write-capable trusted executor immediately before canonical release authorization, so exact source identity, evidence provenance and authority separation must remain fail closed.

acceptanceCriteria: On an admitted release-execution/source/** run, trusted-main Knowledge/Atlas recomputation produces artifacts/shoperation-quality/change-impact.json bound to the exact source SHA before release-risk-budget.mjs executes.
Canonical Release Risk consumes that artifact and remains free to BLOCK; no bypass or policy change is introduced.
Trusted executor does not treat the source CI Knowledge artifact as trusted evidence.
A failed trusted Knowledge/Atlas recomputation prevents the driver from starting.
Exact-head CI for this fix is green, Completion Truth VERIFIED, normal Lifecycle closure committed, then merge and rehearsal replay.
invariants: Atlas and Release Risk remain existing canonical authorities.
SOURCE_SHA remains the admitted source workflow_run head SHA.
Trusted executor code remains checked out from main.
Driver cannot start unless trusted evidence recomputation and Release Risk both pass.
No child PR/state/receipt is created by the fix transaction itself.

failureModes: Trusted Release Risk executes before change-impact evidence exists.
Knowledge preflight evaluates main instead of source HEAD.
Untrusted source artifact is mistaken for trusted evidence.
Proof failure is ignored and driver still starts.
edgeCases: Source diff contains only quality fixtures and an evidence-neutral test.
Source SHA differs from trusted main checkout HEAD.
Knowledge producer needs no repository mutation.
Release Risk still blocks for an unrelated canonical policy violation.

alternatives.summary: Run the existing Knowledge/Atlas producer with trusted main code against exact source HEAD before trusted Release Risk.
alternatives.reason: Preserves canonical producer/consumer chain and trusted provenance.

alternatives.summary: Download change-impact.json from the successful source CI.
alternatives.reason: Would make source-controlled proof output authoritative inside the write-capable executor.

alternatives.summary: Allow Release Risk to proceed when Atlas evidence is absent.
alternatives.reason: Would weaken the canonical Release Risk/Atlas contract.

specialistReviews.finding: The trusted executor has a missing producer-consumer edge: Release Risk consumes canonical Atlas change-impact, but the trusted execution workflow does not invoke the existing producer.
specialistReviews.resolution: Run the existing Knowledge/Atlas producer with trusted default-branch code and exact source transaction identity before Release Risk; create no new authority.

specialistReviews.finding: The executor has repository write credentials, so using a source-generated proof artifact or needlessly exposing the write token to evidence recomputation would weaken the trust boundary.
specialistReviews.resolution: Recompute evidence from trusted main code, do not download source proof artifacts, and explicitly scrub GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN for the proof-only Knowledge/Atlas step.

specialistReviews.finding: Release Risk behaved correctly by blocking when Atlas evidence was absent; the policy itself is not defective.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve release-risk-budget.mjs and deploy/release-risk-policy.json unchanged; satisfy the existing prerequisite before invoking it.

specialistReviews.finding: The live rehearsal exposed an integration gap only at the trusted executor boundary after source CI had already proved the same risk score successfully.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add regression coverage for trusted Knowledge/Atlas → Release Risk ordering and exact-source identity so the edge cannot regress silently.

challenge.scenario: A malicious or buggy release-execution/source branch uploads a forged change-impact.json that claims a smaller diff.
challenge.finding: Consuming that artifact in the write-capable executor would let source-controlled output influence release authorization.
challenge.resolution: Never download source CI Atlas proof; recompute change-impact with trusted main producer code from exact SOURCE_SHA.

challenge.scenario: Trusted Knowledge/Atlas recomputation exits non-zero or emits BLOCK before Release Risk.
challenge.finding: Continuing to Release Risk or the driver would turn missing/invalid prerequisite evidence into an implicit bypass.
challenge.resolution: Keep the producer as an ordinary sequential failing step before Release Risk and driver; no continue-on-error.

challenge.scenario: The executor checkout HEAD is main while the admitted transaction HEAD is a different source SHA.
challenge.finding: A producer using implicit HEAD would generate change-impact for main instead of the admitted source diff.
challenge.resolution: Pass DEVELOPMENT_HEAD_SHA, QUALITY_HEAD_SHA, RELEASE_HEAD_SHA and SHOPERATION_REPLAY_HEAD explicitly as SOURCE_SHA and use the fetched source plan path.

challenge.scenario: Canonical Release Risk finds a real policy violation after valid Atlas evidence has been generated.
challenge.finding: The integration fix must not reinterpret or suppress that BLOCK.
challenge.resolution: Leave release-risk-budget.mjs and its policy untouched and require its normal zero exit before driver execution.

challenge.scenario: The Knowledge/Atlas producer runs inside a job whose default GITHUB_TOKEN can write contents and pull requests.
challenge.finding: Proof-only logic does not need mutation capability and should not inherit write credentials unnecessarily.
challenge.resolution: Override GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN to empty for the Knowledge/Atlas recompute step while retaining exact git data already fetched locally.

challenge.scenario: The source plan path is omitted and trusted Knowledge preflight reads main's closed active plan.
challenge.finding: Atlas change-impact would be computed against the wrong Development Transaction envelope even if SOURCE_SHA is explicit.
challenge.resolution: Bind SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN to artifacts/release-execution/source-plan.json for trusted Knowledge/Atlas recomputation.

challenge.scenario: A later refactor reorders the trusted workflow so Release Risk executes before the Knowledge/Atlas producer.
challenge.finding: The original missing edge would recur while each individual script still exists and works.
challenge.resolution: Add regression assertions for step presence and ordering in the existing production release surface test.

challenge.scenario: Trusted Knowledge/Atlas recomputation succeeds but emits change-impact bound to a SHA or file set other than the exact admitted source.
challenge.finding: Release Risk must fail closed on stale or mismatched evidence rather than accepting producer success alone.
challenge.resolution: Rely on the unchanged release-risk-budget.mjs exact source SHA and changed-file-set checks, and regression-prove the workflow passes SOURCE_SHA explicitly.

proofPlan: Open plan-only fix transaction from exact main and require Plan Before Code PASS before workflow implementation.
Regression-test trusted evidence producer ordering and source exact-head environment binding.
Run exact-head Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Release Risk, full tests, typecheck, build, Completion Truth and normal Lifecycle closure.
Merge exact head, verify fresh main CI, then replay the original rehearsal without manual state reconstruction.

requirements.requirement: Trusted Release Unit Execution must produce canonical exact-source Knowledge/Atlas change-impact evidence before Release Risk and remain fail closed if that producer fails.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Source-controlled proof artifacts may not replace trusted executor recomputation.
Trusted Release Risk may not execute successfully without canonical change-impact evidence.
